children: Northwest Natural Holding announced a settlement in its Texas general rate case that would raise annual revenue requirement by about $8.6 million.
Settlement filed with the Railroad Commission of Texas resolves all issues in the Rate Case and is subject to RRC approval.
Provides for an approximately $8.6M increase in annual revenue requirement versus the original $12.0M request.
Establishes consolidation of SiEnergy Gas, Pines Gas, and Pines Gas Development and systemwide rates.
Sets capital structure at 59.75% equity / 40.25% long-term debt, ROE of 9.8% and overall cost of capital of 8.0%.
Combined rate base about $343M (a $177M increase since 2023); new rates expected to take effect in November 2026.
